summary: Completed Phase 5 testing: AI Help Chat, Starter Templates, Account Deletion, Admin Analytics, and CSV Exports. Backend: 100% pass (16/16 tests). Frontend: Most features working correctly with one minor UI issue in Use Template dialog for multi-role templates.

ui_bugs.issue: Use Template dialog for multi-role templates (e.g., NDA with 2 roles) only shows 1 set of name/email inputs instead of 2. The dialog should display input fields for all roles simultaneously.
ui_bugs.impact: Users can still use the template but the UX is confusing - they may not realize they need to fill multiple roles

passed_tests: Backend: AI Chat endpoint (POST /api/assistant/chat) - responds correctly with Gemini
Backend: Get Starter Templates (GET /api/templates/samples) - returns all 5 templates
Backend: Use Sample Template (POST /api/templates/{id}/use) - creates envelope successfully
Backend: Bulk Send Sample Template (POST /api/templates/{id}/bulk-send) - sends to multiple recipients
Backend: Account Deletion wrong confirmation (DELETE /api/auth/account) - correctly rejects with 400
Backend: Account Deletion correct confirmation (DELETE /api/auth/account) - successfully deletes with 200
Backend: Login with deleted account - correctly returns 401
Backend: Admin Metrics with Analytics (GET /api/admin/metrics) - returns analytics object with funnel, rates, top users
Backend: CSV Export Users (GET /api/admin/export/users.csv) - returns CSV with 200
Backend: CSV Export Envelopes (GET /api/admin/export/envelopes.csv) - returns CSV with 200
Backend: CSV Export Contacts (GET /api/admin/export/contacts.csv) - returns CSV with 200
Frontend: Change password fields NOT pre-filled (autoComplete=new-password working)
Frontend: AI Help Chat widget visible and responds to questions
Frontend: Starter Templates section shows all 5 sample templates
Frontend: Bulk Send dialog works for single-signer templates
Frontend: Admin Analytics section visible with signing funnel and top users panel
Frontend: CSV Export buttons present on admin/users, admin/envelopes, admin/contacts pages
Frontend: Settings tabs (Profile, Subscription, Help) switch correctly
Frontend: Danger zone visible in Settings > Profile
Frontend: Delete account dialog requires typing 'DELETE' to enable confirm button
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix Use Template dialog (Templates.jsx) to display input fields for ALL roles when using multi-role templates. Currently only shows 1 set of inputs for templates with 2+ roles (e.g., NDA). The dialog should render a separate name/email input pair for each role in template.roles array.
